description_en: Start a successfully created Intelligent Contact Robot calling job
description_zh: 启动已创建成功的智能联络机器人呼叫任务
name: StartTask

parameters.help_en: The unique job ID of the robot calling task. You can view it on the Task Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) page or obtain it by using the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html API
parameters.help_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID。在任务管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)页面查看或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html接口获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to start immediately. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No, which means the job will not be started
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即启动。取值：
true：是。
false：否。代表不启动任务
parameters.name: start_now

Code.description_en: Request status code. A value of OK indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation succeeded. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Data.description_zh:
是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call succeeded. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
